name: sa-music-on-nauvis
title: Space Age Music on Nauvis
author: Quell
description: Plays the Space Age soundtrack (Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba, Aquilo and space platform music) in games where the Space Age mod is disabled. The music is not included: unzip the mod and copy it from your own Factorio installation (see the mod page). With Space Age enabled it leaves the music alone, and the music player still works.
